---
title: "Welcome"
description: "Why this site exists, and what to expect from it."
date: "2025-01-15"
categories: [meta]
---

This site collects my research, commentary, and policy work on international
trade — organised by theme rather than by publication type. Three research
programmes anchor it at launch: the trade consequences of Brexit, the
fragmentation of trade under renewed great-power rivalry, and Ukraine's
wartime export economy. A fourth section, [Consultancy](/consultancy/index.qmd),
describes the policy advisory work that runs alongside the academic research.

Posts here will track new papers, data findings, and commentary as they
happen, each tagged into the relevant theme so the hub pages stay current.
The RSS feed (top right) is the best way to follow along.
